# Object

*JavaScript*

Methods every JavaScript object has. Static helpers like `Object.keys(obj)` are called on `Object` itself.

## Methods

### constructor {#constructor}

::: member

The function that created the object, e.g. `Object` for an object literal.

**Returns** `Function`

:::

### hasOwnProperty {#hasownproperty}

::: member

Checks whether the object has the property itself, not through its prototype.

```js
({a: 1}).hasOwnProperty('a'); // true
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `property` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | property name |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the property is the object's own

:::

### isPrototypeOf {#isprototypeof}

::: member

Checks whether this object is in the prototype chain of another object.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `object` | [`Object`](/scripting/js/Object) | object to check |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if it is a prototype of `object`

:::

### propertyIsEnumerable {#propertyisenumerable}

::: member

Checks whether an own property shows up in `for...in` and `Object.keys`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `property` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | property name |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the property is own and enumerable

:::

### toLocaleString {#tolocalestring}

::: member

Converts the object to a string for the language; by default the same as `toString`.

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the text

:::

### toString {#tostring}

::: member

Converts the object to a string, `'[object Object]'` unless overridden. Use `JSON.stringify(obj)` to see the content.

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the text

:::

### valueOf {#valueof}

::: member

Returns the primitive value of the object, or the object itself.

**Returns** `any` — the value

:::
